isolated_export.scope: Headless launch of exact APK assets in an isolated ZIP and user directory; no source files or excluded tests available. Not Android rendering/device acceptance.

latched_gameplay.scope: Ordinary earned Android run: End Deployment, real damage channels/shares, frozen time/RNG/rewards and Back/menu retention verified before any Engineer progress fixture. Mobile physical performance remains unverified.

control_negative_observation.scope: Unpatched diagnostic control failed recovery on cycle 10; collection workflow success is not a recovery pass. Failed transcript/screenshots/logs retained in the control artifact. Development APK uses the previously validated shared repair.

modal_visibility.method: Every complete UI snapshot in five actual Android transcripts is checked. Mobile and both lifecycle transcripts include full paused UI: no visible chain or gameplay buttons, modal controls available; playing restores both HUD actions. Ordinary/latched gameplay transcripts only retain complete playing UI, with condensed pause snapshots covered separately by existing touch regressions. UI headless tests separately cover hints and nested settings/build.

layout_delta.explanation: Two hidden background actions in each of 68 modal layouts remove 272 viewport/touch-size checks; four report layouts also hide the enabled performance label. Remaining geometry/configuration and control counts match.

phone_code_parity.scope: Only compiled HUD presentation changes; Java DEX, native engine, other game modules and shipping project settings match prior verified phone APK.

visual_review.observation: Upgrade/build/pause panels are readable without background HUD text or gameplay controls; actual Mobile earned upgrade and post-return pause plus ordinary Compatibility cycle-18 pause reviewed. Applied-upgrade screen restores HUD. Native staged captures are fixtures; Android Mobile upgrade is genuinely earned.

limits: Actual Mobile/Vulkan software emulator uses explicit Swappy off; normal ARM64 APK preserves default frame pacing.
